content.user_title: Manage Google Forms with the gws CLI
content.value_statement: Managing Google Forms manually makes repeatable administration slow and error-prone. This skill guides reliable form creation, updates, retrieval, publishing, response operations, and schema discovery.
actual_capabilities: Create an empty Google Form with a title and optional document title.
Apply multiple form changes through batchUpdate.
Work with form response and watch resources.
Inspect available methods, parameters, types, and defaults before making API calls.
limitations: The gws CLI and its authentication setup must already be available.
Form creation copies only the title and optional document title.
Items, descriptions, and settings require a later update operation.
Legacy forms do not support publish settings through this API.

use_cases.title: Create a standard form
use_cases.description: Create an empty form, then add approved questions and settings through a separate batch update.

use_cases.title: Automate form maintenance
use_cases.description: Inspect method schemas and apply repeatable updates to existing forms with validated parameters.

use_cases.title: Manage response workflows
use_cases.description: Discover response and watch operations for recurring collection and monitoring tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Forms commands
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the available Google Forms resources and explain how to inspect a method before using it.

prompt_templates.title: Create an empty form
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Google Form titled [title] with the optional document title [document title]. Confirm the planned action first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a batch update
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the batchUpdate schema for form [form ID], then plan changes for [questions or settings]. Validate every required parameter.

prompt_templates.title: Design a monitored response workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect response and watch methods for form [form ID]. Propose a workflow for [goal], including required parameters and operational limits.

output_examples.input: Create a form titled Quarterly Training Survey.
output_examples.output: Planned result: an empty form titled Quarterly Training Survey. Questions and settings require a separate update after creation.

output_examples.input: Can this legacy form use new publish settings?
output_examples.output: No. Legacy forms lack the publish settings field required by the supported method.

output_examples.input: Help me update several questions in one operation.
output: Inspect the batch update method schema.
Validate the form identifier and each requested change.

best_practices: Inspect each method schema before building parameters or request data.
Create the empty form first, then add items and settings through an update.
Confirm form identifiers and publishing changes before modifying remote resources.
anti_patterns: Do not include questions or settings in the initial create request.
Do not guess parameter names, types, or defaults without inspecting the method schema.
Do not apply publish settings to legacy forms that lack the required field.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: The gws CLI must be installed, and the shared authentication guidance must be available.

faq.question: Can form creation include questions?
faq.answer: No. Creation accepts the title and optional document title only. Add questions with a later update.

faq.question: How do I discover supported methods?
faq.answer: Use the Forms help command to browse resources and methods.

faq.question: How do I verify required parameters?
faq.answer: Inspect the selected method schema before preparing parameters and request data.

faq.question: Can the skill update publishing settings?
faq.answer: Yes, for supported forms. Legacy forms do not expose the required publish settings field.

faq.question: Does the skill support responses and watches?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies response and watch resources, while exact operations should be discovered through help and schema inspection.
